title: guettarda antirhoea
intro: Guettarda antirhoea, commonly known as the Butterfly Tree, is a flowering plant species native to tropical Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include treating fever, diarrhea, and skin conditions, as well as its antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Guettarda antirhoea include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and soothe skin irritations. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
